SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{from}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE created_at >= #{from}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE created_at >= #{from}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT target_type, target_id FROM reports WHERE status = 'pending') t
mapper.sql: u.user_id AS userId, u.name, u.login_id AS loginId, u.member_type AS memberType, u.admin_level AS adminLevel, u.created_at AS joinedAt, COALESCE(la.last_access, u.last_login_at) AS lastAccessAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_devices d WHERE d.user_id = u.user_id) AS deviceCount
LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, MAX(access_hour) AS last_access FROM stats_access_hourly GROUP BY user_id) la ON la.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM users u
WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(la.last_access, u.last_login_at, u.created_at) < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY COALESCE(la.last_access, u.last_login_at, u.created_at) ASC, u.user_id ASC

SELECT FROM users u
WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_devices d WHERE d.user_id = u.user_id) ORDER BY COALESCE(la.last_access, u.last_login_at, u.created_at) DESC, u.user_id ASC

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.name, u.login_id AS loginId, u.member_type AS memberType, u.admin_level AS adminLevel, u.created_at AS joinedAt, COALESCE(la.last_access, u.last_login_at) AS lastAccessAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE p.user_id = u.user_id AND p.created_at >= #{from}) AS postCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.user_id = u.user_id AND c.created_at >= #{from}) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_devices d WHERE d.user_id = u.user_id) AS deviceCount FROM users u
WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 HAVING postCount + commentCount > 0 ORDER BY postCount + commentCount DESC, postCount DESC, u.user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE p.board_id = b.board_id AND p.created_at >= #{from}) AS postCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = c.post_id WHERE p.board_id = b.board_id AND c.created_at >= #{from}) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes l JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = l.post_id WHERE p.board_id = b.board_id AND l.created_at >= #{from}) AS likeCount FROM boards b WHERE b.state = 'normal' ORDER BY b.display_order ASC, b.board_id ASC
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS count FROM posts WHERE created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY statDate
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS count FROM comments WHERE created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY statDate
